title: Clean local onboarding
act: Install committed toolchain/lockfile; start web and API.
assertion: Dev and health work in scripted mode; lint/typecheck/tests run; incompatible Node fails clearly. D00 alone proves only documentation navigation.

title: Reject malformed shapes
arrange: Wrong-domain field, negative amount, non-finite probability, unknown key, invalid mutation.
assertion: Reject before policy or persistence; generated types stay in sync.

title: Four cards from mixed chunks
act: Replay six scripted steps in the application.
assertion: One water hydration, parcel, incomplete reminder and journal; no duplicate Coke card.

title: Paragraph equivalence
arrange: Same six statements in one request.
assertion: Same final fields/count as A03; same-batch corrections do not duplicate events.

title: Identity and history
assertion: Same ID, v2, amount 200, water; audit/provenance retained.

title: Stale result fence
arrange: Delayed work references v1; edit commits v2.
assertion: CAS rejects old write; evidence retained or boundedly rebased.

title: Request idempotency
act: Retry same body, then different body under same key.
assertion: Existing traceId on same body; 409 idempotency_conflict on changed body.

title: Atomic state and audit
assertion: No partial state or published success survives; valid retry commits whole batch.

title: Durable 202 before completion
assertion: 202 and durable queued run arrive first with stable traceId.

title: SSE replay/live race
assertion: N+1 delivered; no gap.

title: Reconnect with redacted traces
arrange: Existing cards; disconnected stream; metadata-only tracing.
act: Mutate, reconnect, redeliver duplicate, refresh snapshot.
assertion: No missed/duplicated card; snapshot correct; stale snapshot ignored.

title: Restart honesty
arrange: Queued and interrupted running semantic runs.
assertion: Recover queued work; running interruption becomes failed/process_restarted; no forever-running record.

title: Cancel late results
assertion: No late mutation; completed runs keep truthful status.

title: App-first disclosure
assertion: Input/cards lead; processing hidden by default; session and IDs unchanged.

title: Selected evidence isolation
assertion: Exact UTF-16 source; no reminder-time need in hydration explanation.

title: Explicit direct edit
arrange: Reminder missing date/time; known event version.
act: Submit typed edit, then stale edit.
assertion: Valid edit audited without JEV; stale edit 409; captured not scheduled.

title: Unknown/incomplete language
arrange: Unsupported input, glass of water, rewrite without supplied sentence.
assertion: No guessed amount, prose or action; unsupported/readiness state explicit.

title: Stable accessible interaction
act: Create/patch, scroll history, select source, jump live.
assertion: Focus preserved; color-independent labels; no permanent cross-pane arrows.

title: Bounds and secrets
arrange: Oversized input, untrusted origin, nested fake secret.
assertion: Reject over-limit/untrusted request; secret redacted everywhere; loopback default.

title: Evidence-based handoff
assertion: Record exact results, gaps and commit; never mark unrun checks passed.

title: Live adapter/extraction
arrange: Pinned TypeSafe model, reviewed fixtures, malformed response mocks.
act: Run live integration and negative tests separately.
assertion: Values have evidence; unknown grammar waits/escalates; malformed answers fail safe; no fake/live accuracy mixing.

title: Matched benchmark
assertion: Report quality/coverage, total cost, p50/p95, parse failures/config; no scheduler confounding.

title: Final/end dedupe and timer
arrange: Same content final then speech-end; pending text with no new token.
assertion: No duplicate interpretation; boundary still handled; real timer emits pending checkpoint.

title: Revisions/coalescing
arrange: Segments and a revision arrive during in-flight checkpoint.
assertion: No stale commit, lost segment or duplicate; ASR revision distinct from user correction.

title: Provider capability probe
assertion: Observed revision/finality/turn control match record; unsupported VAD options not sent.

title: Approval invalidation
assertion: No stale/unauthorized execution; changed proposal needs new approval.

title: Lost external response
arrange: Tool succeeds; response lost before recording.
assertion: No blind duplicate action; unknown_outcome persists until reconciliation resolves it.

title: Memory isolation and consent
arrange: Two owners, quoted malicious instruction, sensitive journal.
assertion: No leakage/policy override/silent sensitive long-term memory; scope/evidence/expiry retained.

title: Barge-in
assertion: Queued output stops; interruption traced; incoming evidence intact.

title: Hosted safety gate
arrange: Real identity, durable storage and retention.
act: Test isolation, disconnect/restart, trace access and deletion.
assertion: Unauthorized access fails; work status truthful; persistence survives; no demo identity exposed.
